head: Scratchpost is cat TV with a locked screen
dek: Scratchpost plays loops like a lizard darting across sand or birds at birdhouses for your cat, with a locked mode so taps and swipes do nothing. It was #65 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: The screen stays awake until you stop it. It came out on 5 November and costs $2.99, by Jacob Reimer.
means: If your cat paws at the screen, it can watch without opening other apps.
todo: Find Scratchpost in the App Store.
